description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (402.836) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (357.269) less the matching prior-year period (289.007).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 402.836，加本财年累计 357.269，减去上年同期累计 289.007。

description.en: The model holds the latest reported standalone quarter’s diluted weighted-average share count constant.
description.zh: 模型固定采用本季已披露的加权平均摊薄股数。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: AI search monetization trails usage while cloud depreciation rises.
rationale.zh: AI 搜索变现慢于使用增长，云业务折旧上升。

rationale.en: Search monetization holds and cloud backlog converts into recognized sales.
rationale.zh: 搜索变现保持稳定，云积压订单逐步转化为收入。

rationale.en: AI search and cloud both grow without proportional cost increases.
rationale.zh: AI 搜索与云业务同步增长，成本增幅较低。
